description: Raforkuframleiðsla frá 1915 eftir tegundum orku is a dataset listed in Open Data Iceland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Orkustofnun. The list contains information on electricity production since 1915 by type of energy (hydroelectricity, Geothermal Energy, Wind Energy and Fuel). The numbers are in GWH. Coverage: Orkustofnun. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity generation from 1915 by type of energy" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Orkustofnun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opingogn.is/pages/notkunarleidbeiningar). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-iceland.
